title: Hono API
about: A small REST API written with Hono, one Lambda function behind an HTTP API: a greeting at `/`, a list of posts at `GET /posts`, and `POST /posts`. Its only dependency is `hono`, which makes it the smallest application here and the closest to what a first Lambda API looks like.

edit.to: 'Hello from Hono on AWS Lambda, edited!'

changesFromStarter: Every direct dependency is pinned to an exact version, the newest within the starter's own range.
